# =============================================================================
# requirements.lock.txt - hash-locked Python deps for the MOD API image (FX.147 p2a).
#
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Build input: the Dockerfile installs it with
# `pip install --no-deps --require-hashes -r requirements.lock.txt`, so every
# wheel is verified against the sha256 below and a rebuild can never silently
# swap in a yanked / typosquatted wheel.
#
# The human-edited source is requirements.txt (floors/ranges + the WHY comments
# for each pin). Regenerate THIS file when you change that source, INSIDE the
# running image so the pins match what is actually deployed (never from a bare
# host - it would resolve to newer versions and change behaviour):
#
#   scripts/regen_python_locks.sh api             # see scripts/regen_python_locks.sh
#
# Generated from the LIVE my_fastapi_app pip freeze (the exact deployed wheel
# set), hashes taken from PyPI's published sha256 for each release's wheel
# files. torch is excluded: its CPU wheel comes from download.pytorch.org
# (no published digests) and is installed by its own allow-unhashed line.
# =========================================================================
